title: Lezginka
tagline: Stamp, lift and spin as the tempo climbs.
description: A rhythm game about the fast folk dance of the Caucasus. Tap four step pads (left boot, right boot, arms and spin) as rings close in, in time with a drum and an accordion. Learn five original dances phrase by phrase, then dance them while the tempo climbs and more dancers join the floor. Watch and Learn demonstration, calibration, in-app Rules page. Real 3D dancers in festival costume, synthesised sound, no ads, works offline.
howToPlay: Pick a dance, then start with Learn the steps: the teacher dances a phrase and you echo it.
Four pads surround the dancer: left boot, right boot, arms and spin.
Tap a pad when its ring lands on the rim. Closer to the beat scores more.
Use two thumbs, or more fingers.
Dance cleanly and more dancers join the floor. Miss and one group sits out.
The tempo climbs through every dance.
Watch and Learn performs the whole dance for you. Pause it any time.
Keyboard: A, D, W, S or the arrow keys for the pads, Space pauses.
